what.text: This page follows refugees from China living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2417 Chinese refugees in Germany, 1.6% of all refugees from China.
India hosts the most Chinese refugees, followed by the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 6280 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6940, at the end of 2003, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
